material.acceptance_criteria: Each of the four matrix legs of the net-host-persistent job succeeds on the pushed sha; the job prints 'net host persistent ok ticks=50 ratio=...'.
material.description: The Node net host (js/host/guest.js) runs one persistent wasip1 guest over anonymous stdio pipes and drives it for 50 ticks with one order. CI job 'net host keeps one wasip1 guest across 50 ticks (<os>)' runs on ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest and windows-latest (matrix in .github/workflows/ci.yml). It asserts ticks advanced exactly 50 and last-10/first-10 tick-cost ratio <= 3, and prints 'net host persistent ok ticks=50 ratio=<r>'.
material.resolution: One long-lived wasip1 guest per host, run as a child process over spawn pipes on Linux, macOS and Windows; unit records (id, kind, player, x, y, hp) read each tick; 50-tick check passes on four legs including arm; tick cost ratio stays under 3.
